title: Compute and persistent disk sizing for clinical IOPS

spec.title: Compute and persistent disk sizing for clinical IOPS
spec.lead: N2 high-memory instances paired with Extreme Persistent Disks meet clinical latency requirements.

rows.solution: Machine type: n2-highmem-32 instances on primary and secondary nodes for buffer pool caching.
Log storage: pd-extreme volumes provisioned with dedicated IOPS for sub-millisecond transaction log hardening.
Data storage: separate pd-ssd volumes for user database files and high-concurrency tempdb isolation.
Network tier: dedicated egress bandwidth allocations on N2 instances to prevent replication queue buildup.

spec.notes: Each SQL Server replica runs on an n2-highmem-32 Compute Engine VM to keep working clinical datasets in memory. We isolate transaction logs onto pd-extreme volumes for sub-millisecond write hardening while placing data files and tempdb on separate pd-ssd volumes with dedicated egress bandwidth.
